'''Rugar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who lived during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They wore light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a large red shape in the center of their [[shirt]]. Rugar had brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], though their eyebrows were black. Rugar also had lightly colored skin with a small scar on their left cheek. As a soldier, Rugar wielded [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]] such as the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], a [[Rail detonator]], and the [[Imperial repeater rifle]].<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rugar first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a character who only appeared in the game's multiplayer addition as a playable character model.<ref name="Jedi" /> Rget appeared again in ''Jedi Knight's'' expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. ''Mysteries of the Sith'' introduced "multiplayer personalities," a form of character creation that put different character models under different professions. Each profession also had their own set of starting weapons for a match, with Rugar being categorized as a soldier. Rugar's body texture was a slightly modified version of the body texture used by another multiplayer character named [[Santiago]]. Due to their multiplayer only appearances, Rugar's place in [[canon]] is uncertain.<ref name="Sith" />
